goal: Bring the Tarot reading flow to the approved design canvas: step 1/2 asks the question with a local reframing suggestion, an auto-detected topic, spread cards and the selected deck on one screen; step 2/2 draws per position from a fanned deck; the result screen leads with the summary, per-card sections and a fixed Save / Ask further dock.
successCriteria: Step 1/2 (topic stage) shows the question field, a local suggestion card when the question asks to read another person or to predict (Dùng câu này / Giữ câu của tôi, with an honest note), topic chips Tình yêu, Công việc, Bản thân, Quyết định that follow the question until the person picks one, spread cards for the three existing spreads, and the selected deck with Đổi; the primary button reads Bắt đầu rút bài and goes straight to the draw stage.

Step 2/2 (draw stage) shows the question, a slot per spread position, a prompt naming the next position, a fanned deck to tap, Rút ngẫu nhiên and Lật cả N lá ngay; allowance checks and haptics stay as they are.

The result screen shows the cards with positions and Vietnamese names, a Tóm lại panel with the AI or reference source line, one collapsible section per card using AI sections whose cardIds match (reference meaning otherwise), the reflection question with Viết vào Nhật ký, and a fixed dock with Lưu trải bài, Hỏi tiếp and a menu for share and report. Blocks for which the AI returned nothing are hidden.
The two new spreads stay hidden; no Edge Function, prompt or migration change is made in this task.
npm --workspace apps/mobile run check and the mobile Jest suite pass, and a 390x844 web walkthrough covers ask, draw and result.
untouchedSurfaces: Spreads data, AI prompt, Edge Functions and database are unchanged; the 3-card love and 4-card crossroads spreads are not shown.
Card guide screen (previous task), deck detail, learn and share stages keep their layout.
Allowance rules, journal storage and chat handoff contracts are unchanged.

impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: Backend, spreads data, share and journal formats.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, runs the validation commands, commits locally and does not merge, deploy or run SQL.
